summary: CI signing pipeline secret rotation (offline bundle signing): rotate service account + KMS/HSM creds and validate end-to-end signing
description:
Background
- We’re approaching pilot/RC for Redwood Private signed offline bundles. Security requested we rotate CI secrets used by the signing stage to align with least-privilege + auditability requirements.
- This ticket covers rotation of CI tokens/service accounts used by the signing pipeline (NOT the long-term signing private key itself). The signing key remains in protected KMS/HSM custody per key ceremony.

Scope
1) Rotate CI credentials used to:
   - authenticate from CI runner to secrets backend (Vault/KMS broker)
   - access the signing service/operator endpoint (where applicable)
   - write signed artifacts + signature metadata to the internal artifact store
2) Update CI pipeline config to reference the new secrets.
3) Validate end-to-end: build offline bundle -> generate manifest -> sign -> publish -> installer verify in preflight.
4) Capture evidence (timestamps, job URLs, approver notes) needed for compliance/customer questionnaires.

Systems / impacted pipelines
- repo: release pipeline job “private-offline-bundle-sign” (Release Train)
- repos consuming outputs: redwood-private-installer (preflight verify), redwood-helm-charts (chart tarball checksums referenced by manifest)

Change window
- Preferred: 09:00–12:00 PT during business hours to keep Release Eng available.

Risks
- If CI loses access to signing step, Private release artifacts may be blocked.
- If wrong creds are rotated, pipeline may fall back to unsigned artifacts (must be prevented by gating; confirm fail-closed behavior).

Acceptance criteria
- Old CI credentials revoked/disabled.
- Signing stage succeeds in staging and produces:
  - bundle manifest
  - detached signature file
  - signing metadata (key id / trust root reference)
- Installer preflight verification passes using a staging bundle.
- Audit log contains entries showing:
  - secret rotation event (where available)
  - signing job execution with new identity
- Rollback plan documented (re-enable previous creds only with Security approval, time-boxed).

Owners / reviewers
- Assignee (CI): Sahana Iyer
- Secrets/KMS: Hanae Suzuki
- Release: Connor O’Brien
- Security review: Marcus Lin

Notes
- This rotation is part of ongoing hardening following the signing key ceremony; see evidence guide for required artifacts/screenshots.
